supplementarySources.evidenceRole: Supplementary operator article and its reported tests; not labelled an official developer FAQ.
findings: A Slash output is ordinary, uses the material suit and counts toward the native Slash allowance.
A victim dying after the actual Juguan damage does not remove the possible +2 reward.
The Juguan Duel can hurt Gao Gan himself and still qualify unless he later deals damage to himself.
Skipping the next actual turn Draw loses this reward instead of delaying it to a later turn.
Additional Play phases and additional victims never stack the draw beyond +2. Any one actual damaged victim not retaliating suffices; every recorded victim retaliating means no +2.

implementationNotes: Each accepted native Use freezes its own actual CardUseFrameId, ActionId, exact conversion source and one real Hand cost. A physical card merely shown or another use of the same material cannot arm this benefit.

Victims come from real positive applied damage whose native producer is that issued CardUseFrameId. Self damage in its Duel and linked multiple victims are retained; prevented damage and unrelated skill/card damage do not fabricate victims.

Retaliation is real sourced applied damage from a recorded victim to the exact original skill owner after that victim has actually received the Juguan card damage, up to the next actual owner TurnStarted boundary. A mere loss of HP, prevention, or damage from another seat does not qualify.
The initial damaging receipt itself is never also its own retaliation. Immediate after-damage retaliation is counted according to the primary wording; no added exclusion waits for CardUseFinished.

A supplementary fan rules rewrite at https://moegirl.uk/三国杀:高干 introduces after-card-resolution timing absent from the official text, current client and operator FAQ. This module does not silently import that extra timing condition; the selected timing is a clearly identified literal-text inference.

The next actual own turn freezes at most +2 independently of later source skill loss. Its first real Draw phase token owns the modifier; additional Draw phases do not copy it, and a skipped phase expires it. The pure draw-count query never consumes pending state.

Extra actual turns are real next-owner-turn deadlines. A face-down skipped turn never carries the old reward to a later turn. All rule facts are scalar or immutable scalar records and replay is rebuilt from accepted commands.
